name: Data Breach Response Playbook
description: Respond to suspected data exfiltration or unauthorised data access.

steps.name: Confirm the breach
steps.description: Verify that data was accessed or exfiltrated.

steps.name: Contain the breach
steps.description: Isolate the affected asset to stop ongoing exfiltration.

steps.name: Preserve evidence
steps.description: Snapshot logs, indicators and risk context with an integrity hash.

steps.name: Block exfiltration destinations
steps.description: Block attacker infrastructure observed in events.

steps.name: Assess data exposure
steps.description: Determine which data sets and records were accessed or exfiltrated.

steps.name: Legal and regulatory assessment
steps.description: Determine notification duties (e.g. CERT-In within 6 hours, DPDP Act, GDPR).

steps.name: Notify regulators and affected parties
steps.description: Submit required notifications and inform affected individuals.

steps.name: Remediate root cause
steps.description: Fix the weakness that enabled the breach and rotate exposed credentials.

steps.name: Post-incident review
steps.description: Run a lessons-learned session and update controls.
